fact: The 2021-2025 national cybersecurity strategy records that the CI-CERT's decree makes reporting of security incidents to it mandatory, and that the CI-CERT was officialised by decree in 2020.
title: Stratégie nationale de cybersécurité 2021-2025
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie Numérique, des Télécommunications et de l'Innovation
